title: 七大姑八大姨
setting: Grandma's flat on New Year's Eve. Every relative you have, one hallway.

caught.en: Come, come, sit down. Let's have a proper chat.

caught.narr: You're sat down between Second Aunt and Eldest Aunt. Someone hands you a dumpling.
caught.zh: 你被按在了二姨和大姑中间。

caught.en: Caught. Dinner lasts four hours, and every question gets asked twice.
caught.zh: 这顿年夜饭，吃了四个小时。

steps.narr: New Year's Eve. You step into Grandma's flat, and every relative turns to look.
steps.zh: 除夕，你一进门，亲戚们全看过来了。
哎呀，回来啦！有对象了吗？
steps.en: Oh, you're back! Seeing anyone yet?

not.note: That says you ARE in a hurry. 不着急 = no rush.

say.tip: 还早呢 = it's early yet. 不着急 bù zháojí = no rush. Together they close the subject without being rude.

4.gloss: No rush. Good things are worth waiting for!
4.tip: 好饭不怕晚 hǎo fàn bú pà wǎn = a good meal is worth the wait: the saying that answers 'still single?'. 不着急 = no rush.

key.好饭不怕晚: good things are worth the wait

steps.narr: The living room. Third Uncle gets up off the sofa.

say.gloss: The right one hasn't come along yet.
say.tip: 缘分 yuánfèn = the fate that brings two people together. 缘分没到 = the right one hasn't come along, and nobody argues with fate.

fail.en: You're not getting any younger. Get a move on!

2.tip: 还没对象呢 = there's nobody yet (对象 duìxiàng = the one you're seeing): 还没……呢 is 'not yet', and the 呢 keeps it light.

answers: 缘分没到，强扭的瓜不甜！
缘分还没到，强扭的瓜不甜！
看缘分吧，强扭的瓜不甜。
4.gloss: Fate hasn't brought anyone yet. You can't force these things!
4.tip: 强扭的瓜不甜 qiǎng niǔ de guā bù tián = a melon picked by force isn't sweet: love can't be forced. 缘分没到 = the right one hasn't come along.

key.强扭的瓜不甜: you can't force it (a forced melon isn't sweet)

steps.narr: The dinner table. Eldest Aunt, waiting for you.

steps.en: So what are you making a month these days?

say.gloss: Enough to live on, that's all.
say.tip: 够花就行 = enough to live on, and that's all that matters. It answers 'how much' without a number. 挣 zhèng = earn.

alts.en: Or: ask what her son makes
alts.gloss: And how much does my cousin make a month?

4.gloss: Enough to live on. I'm happy with what I've got!
4.tip: 知足常乐 zhīzú cháng lè = be content and you'll always be happy: the saying that ends any talk of money. 够花就行 = enough to live on.

steps.narr: The bedroom. Your little nephew has been listening the whole time.
steps.zh: 卧室里，小侄子一直在偷听。

say.gloss: The right one just hasn't come along yet!
say.tip: 还没……呢 = not yet: 还没到呢, 还没吃呢. The 呢 keeps it gentle, even with a six-year-old.

ok.en: What's fate? Can you eat it?

2.gloss: The right one just hasn't come along yet!

4.en: Dodge the kid: fate can't be forced!
answers: 缘分还没到，强扭的瓜不甜！
缘分没到呢，强扭的瓜不甜！
等缘分呗，强扭的瓜不甜！
4.gloss: Fate just hasn't brought anyone yet. You can't force it!
4.tip: 强扭的瓜不甜 = a melon picked by force isn't sweet: love can't be forced. 缘分还没到 = the right one hasn't come along yet.

key.强扭的瓜不甜: you can't force it (a forced melon isn't sweet)

steps.narr: Second Aunt is back, phone out, a photo ready.

steps.en: Come here, Auntie's going to set you up!

say.gloss: No, no, it's far too early!
say.tip: 不用不用 = no need, no need: doubled, it's a warm but firm no. 还早着呢 = oh, it's far too early.

ok.en: Then I'll keep this one for you!

fail.zh: 好，我把你微信推过去了！
fail.en: Right, I've sent them your WeChat!

4.en: No thanks: good things take time!
answers: 不用不用，不急，好饭不怕晚！
谢谢二姨，不着急，好饭不怕晚！
不用了，还早呢，好饭不怕晚！
谢谢，真不急，好饭不怕晚！
4.gloss: No, no, there's no rush. Good things are worth waiting for!
4.tip: 不用不用 = no need, no need: warm but firm. 好饭不怕晚 = good things are worth the wait: a set-up turned down with a smile.

key.好饭不怕晚: good things are worth the wait

steps.narr: The whole family is closing in on the front door.
steps.zh: 一大家子人都围过来了。

say.en: Make an excuse: out you go!
answers: 我去楼下买个东西，马上回来！
say.gloss: I'm just popping down for soy sauce!

not.note: 卖 mài is sell; you're going to buy, 买 mǎi. Same sound, the tone tells them apart.

say.tip: 下楼 = go downstairs. Popping out for soy sauce is the classic escape; 打酱油 even means 'just passing through, nothing to do with me'.

fail.en: We've got everything here! Sit down!

4.en: Make an excuse: back in a flash!
answers: 我下楼买瓶酱油，去去就回！
我下楼买点儿东西，马上回来！
我出去买瓶酱油，去去就回！
我去楼下买个东西，马上就回来！
4.gloss: Just popping down for soy sauce. Back in a flash!
4.tip: 去去就回 qù qù jiù huí = back in a flash: the promise that gets you out of any door. 下楼 = go downstairs.

steps.narr: The stairwell. Dark, quiet, and already occupied.
steps.zh: 楼道里黑黑的，台阶上坐着个人。

say.tip: 别提了 bié tí le = don't even ask, don't get me started. For any ordeal: exams, flights, relatives.

ok.zh: 嗑瓜子吗？等春晚开始再回去。
ok.en: Sunflower seeds? We'll go back in when the Gala starts.

fail.en: What's up? Getting the marriage talk again?

4.en: Sigh: don't ask. She's hiding too!
4.gloss: Don't even ask! Aren't you in the same boat?
4.tip: 你不也一样吗？ = aren't you the same?: a question that's really fellow feeling. 别提了 = don't even ask.

steps.en: Escaped. You and your cousin hide in the stairwell with the sunflower seeds until the Spring Festival Gala starts.
steps.zh: 你和表姐在楼道里，一直躲到春晚开始。
